turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, is that Derek? This is an automated call from Fieldgate Surgery, following up on your appointment. I am not able to take questions, but the practice will read everything you tell me. If you would rather not talk now, just hang up and we will not call again.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Since your appointment, are you feeling better, about the same, or worse?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: About the same, really. No worse anyway.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Your medication was changed at that appointment. Are you managing to take it as prescribed?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: No. I've still got the old box and the new one and I've been taking both, which I don't think is right.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Is there anything you would like the practice to know?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Just that nobody has told me to stop the old tablets.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like to be seen again about this?

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: I don't know. If someone could just tell me which one to take, that would do.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Someone at the practice will read this today. Goodbye.
